'''R4-P44''' was a [[R4 astromech droid/Legends|R4-series]] [[Astromech droid/Legends|astromech droid]] that was assigned to [[Jedi General/Legends|Jedi General]] [[Obi-Wan Kenobi/Legends|Obi-Wan Kenobi's]] [[212th Attack Battalion/Legends|clone trooper forces]] while stationed on [[Utapau/Legends|Utapau]]. It was used aboard an [[Aggressive ReConnaissance-170 starfighter/Legends|ARC-170 starfighter]] of the [[Fifth Fleet/Legends|Fifth Fleet]]. The [[Droid/Legends|droid]], like [[R4-P17/Legends|R4-P17]] and [[R4-G9/Legends|R4-G9]], had the dome of an [[R2-series astromech droid/Legends|R2 unit]].

==Behind the scenes==
Droids visually identical to R4-P44 appears in ARC-170 bombers on [[Coruscant/Legends|Coruscant]] and [[Cato Neimoidia/Legends|Cato Neimoidia]] during the course of ''Revenge of the Sith'', but it is never shown on Utapau as is described in several sources.

[[Hasbro]] has produced an action figure of R4-P44 as part of their Build-A-Droid line and [[the LEGO Group]] included R4-P44 in the [[2010]] version of the ARC-170 Starfighter.<ref name="LEGO">{{LEGOCite|num=8088|name=ARC-170 Starfighter}}</ref>
